description: Aux send bus for the Daisy Mix chain, collecting the send amounts set on the DC2 strips earlier in the chain and offering them as a stereo pair

params.text: Each press switches this module between aux group 1 and aux group 2, shown by the two blue lamps, and it then collects the sends set to that group

outputs.text: The left side of the collected sends from the DC2 strips earlier in the chain that carry a send amount for the selected group
The right side of the collected sends from the DC2 strips earlier in the chain that carry a send amount for the selected group

notes: This module takes the running mix from the daisy module touching its left edge and passes it unchanged to the one touching its right edge, adding nothing of its own to the mix
Bringing processed aux signal back into the mix takes a further DC2 strip placed later in the chain as a return
The two lamps in the blue DAISY band light when a daisy module is linked on the left and on the right
The two outputs are silent until a DC2 strip earlier in the chain has its Aux Group 1 or Aux Group 2 Send Amt raised on that strip's right-click menu; every strip starts at 0%.
